# located at

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:locatedAt`](gmeow-locatedAt.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/locatedAt>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an entity to a location it is situated at, resides in, or occurs at — geographic, virtual, or storage.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to situate any entity at a geographic, virtual, or storage location; location propagates up the containment ladder via the [`locatedAt`](gmeow-locatedAt.md) ∘ [`containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md) chain.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for digital bytes resting in a store (use the narrower [`gmeow:storedIn`](gmeow-storedIn.md)) and avoid for mereological place-in-place containment (use [`gmeow:containedInPlace`](gmeow-containedInPlace.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:locatedAt`](gmeow-locatedAt.md) to the most specific [`Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md); enclosing locations are derived by the property chain, so do not also assert every ancestor by hand.

### Examples

- ex:lillith [`gmeow:locatedAt`](gmeow-locatedAt.md) ex:office.
